entries.desc: docs/adversarial-review-spec.md §1 motivates the capability and cites the S4(B-fa7c)/S5(B-086b)/B-b29e defects with story IDs; WHY: the evidence grounds the methodology

evidence.note: §1 motivates + cites S4/B-fa7c, S5/B-086b, B-b29e defects with story IDs.

entries.desc: each cited defect is attributed to the component that actually filed it (S4 crash=quality/crashsafe lens; S5 express+rollback doors=completeness critic; B-b29e over-registration=critic), verifiable against findings.json; WHY: mis-attribution destroys credibility (INIT-003)

evidence.note: §1.2 attributes each defect to its filing component (S4 crash=claude-quality lens; S5 doors=completeness critic; B-b29e=critic), verified by the implementer against findings.json.

entries.desc: the section does NOT overclaim that single-pass review is useless — it argues single-pass MISSES integration-level defects, which the cited evidence supports; WHY: honest framing

evidence.note: §1.3 frames honestly — single-pass misses integration-level defects, not 'useless'.

entries.desc: §2/§3 define the data shapes: lens, finding{severity,file,line,issue,fix}, verdict{isReal,agreedSeverity,reasoning}; WHY: a builder needs concrete schemas

the per-finding adversarial-verification rule is precise (M skeptics, default-refute, the majority-confirm threshold) and the completeness-critic contract + convergence criterion are stated unambiguously; WHY: these are the core novel mechanics

evidence.note: §2.3/§2.4 define the M-skeptic default-refute majority-confirm rule + completeness-critic contract + §3 convergence criterion.

entries.desc: the methodology is defined as a Lattice review MODE, NOT as a dependency on the harness Workflow tool; WHY: must be implementable inside Lattice

evidence.note: §3.3 defines the methodology as a Lattice review MODE, harness-independent (not a Workflow-tool dependency).

entries.desc: §4 defines how the capability composes the existing lattice-review-* lanes + review_run/pass/finding + full-3x2 escalation; WHY: compose, do not reinvent

evidence.note: §4 composes lattice-review-* lanes + review_run/pass/finding + full-3x2 escalation.

entries.desc: §4 has an explicit MVP-vs-future split with every future surface labeled not-yet-implemented; and states how a critic-reopened round binds to the escalation ledger + materialHash freshness; WHY: honesty + the trickiest integration detail

evidence.note: §4.4 MVP-vs-future table (future labeled not-yet-implemented) + §4.3 critic-reopen->ledger/materialHash binding + §4.5 local-verdicts-not-Authority note.

entries.desc: full-3x2 is defined inline (3 rounds x 2 independent PASS hosts); WHY: standalone-readable
